fieldData.full-article-text:
Yes, we encourage all XRD holders to stake their XRD to good validator nodes as greater stake provides greater protection for the network against sybil attack – and so we intend to stake tokens for the same reason.

A portion of these tokens will be delegated to Radix Token Jersey Limited nodes which may, as a result, be selected as part of the validator set – or will simply be available as a backstop to enter the validator set if there is a significant disruption to community-run nodes for any reason. The Radix Foundation and any subsidiaries aim to stake a total quantity of XRD to Radix-operated nodes that is no more than 25% of the total XRD staked at any given time – well short of the 33.3% threshold which would confer the ability to disrupt the network (even by accident), and also to make clear that control of the network always belongs in the hands of a decentralized community.

Any staking above the 25% level is intended to  be distributed across the widest possible selection of validator nodes that we believe are trustworthy and performant. This may include nodes below the threshold for selection in the top 100 as an active validator in order to assist with backstop against disruption (even though no rewards may result from this delegation). 

Click here for more info.
